![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151148/assets/41d9a3bcc715c0d5db4a910906f471695455065d198d90f3fa6d540e8cdb1c03.png)

For the diagram shown above, which of the following statements are true?

I. The segments $\overset{―}{BC}$ and $\overset{―}{CD}$ are congruent

II. $\overset{―}{AE}≅\overset{―}{AB}$

III. $BD=4\,\text{cm}$
question.worked_solution:
- Statement I is false. From the picture, the two segments $\overset{―}{BC}$ and $\overset{―}{CD}$ have different hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{BC}≇\overset{―}{CD}.
$$

- Statement II is true. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{AE}$ and $\overset{―}{AB}$ have the same hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{AE}≅\overset{―}{AB}.
$$

- Statement III is false. From the picture, the two $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{BD}$ have different hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{AB}≇\overset{―}{BD}.
$$

Hence, $AB\ne BD,$ and since $AB=4\,\text{cm},$ we have $BD\ne 4\,\text{cm}.$

Therefore, only statement II is true.
